name: HyperliquidX 0.1.8
body:
HyperliquidX 0.1.8 improves trading authorization, wallet management and order book reliability.

- Enable Trading now requires only API Wallet authorization. HyperliquidX Builder fees are waived during early access; Hyperliquid's own trading fees still apply. Existing sessions can be reused, and pending wallet approval can be canceled. The dialog explains where to renew or revoke the session.
- Add watch-only wallets from Connect Wallet, and keep Manage Session authorization accessible across multiple wallets.
- Improve L4 depth and individual-order previews, snapshot consistency and reconnection handling. Reduce unnecessary order projections and fix excessive menu bar memory use.
- Improve HTTP compatibility on macOS 14 by disabling unused tracing. Add Firebase Crashlytics and release symbol uploads to help diagnose crashes.
- Refine order cancellation for watched accounts and unify trading action buttons.
- Exit an expanded chart with Escape, with a visible shortcut hint. Production builds stay on Mainnet.
